REQ-001.design_rationale: Section 1 and Section 3.1 specify the multi-module Gradle structure under Sources/OpenKey/android/ (:openkey-core pure JVM Kotlin library and :app Android InputMethodService + Jetpack Compose shell with minSdk=29, targetSdk=35, android:directBootAware="true", and zero INTERNET permission).
REQ-001.tasks_rationale: Task 1.1, Task 1.2, Task 7.1, and Task 8.1 define actionable steps for scaffolding settings.gradle.kts, build.gradle.kts, AndroidManifest.xml, and running JVM/Android unit and assemble tasks.
REQ-001.debate_rationale: ADR-001 evaluates value-type boundary trade-offs between :openkey-core and :app and rejects single-module coupling and C++/JNI bridging.

REQ-002.design_rationale: Section 3.1.1 details VietnameseData.kt, VietnameseEngine.kt, and VietnameseEnginePhonotactics.kt bitmask structures, CHR(idx) bounds checks, findAndCalculateVowel(forGrammar) gi-/qu- backward scanning, handleModernMark/handleOldMark purity, handleDeleteKey state synchronization, and checkRestoreIfWrongSpelling.
REQ-002.tasks_rationale: Task 2.1 and Task 2.2 specify TDD unit tests in VietnameseEngineTest.kt and the core engine implementation.
REQ-002.debate_rationale: ADR-002 justifies the 1:1 unsigned 32-bit syllable bitmask port from OpenKeySwiftCore and rejects ad-hoc regex/string Telex parsers.

REQ-003.design_rationale: Section 3.1.2 specifies VietnameseDictionary.kt and BilingualAutoSwitchEngine.kt with droppedKeys raw keystroke reconstruction, doubled-tone escape repair, standalone English collision restoration, and 2-word look-back phrase restoration.
REQ-003.tasks_rationale: Task 3.1 and Task 3.2 define TDD unit tests in BilingualAutoSwitchTest.kt and implementation of VietnameseDictionary.kt and BilingualAutoSwitchEngine.kt.
REQ-003.debate_rationale: ADR-003 analyzes multi-word backspace batch replacement trade-offs and rejects manual VI/EN switching for mid-sentence code-switching.

REQ-004.design_rationale: Section 3.1.3 defines lock-isolated AutoWordingEngine.kt using OKWordContext, diacritic-preserving stem completion, user frequency ranking, phonotactic cluster repair, and custom shorthand expansion.
REQ-004.tasks_rationale: Task 4.1 and Task 4.2 cover TDD tests in AutoWordingEngineTest.kt and AutoWordingEngine.kt implementation.
REQ-004.debate_rationale: ADR-004 justifies in-memory dictionary heap trade-offs (~1.5 MB) and rejects Binder IPC queries to Android UserDictionary ContentProvider.

REQ-005.design_rationale: Section 3.2.1 and Section 3.2.2 define InputContextEvaluator.kt for password/URI/email/numeric/terminal bypass and InputConnectionCommitter.kt for atomic beginBatchEdit/deleteSurroundingText/commitText/endBatchEdit replacement without setComposingText.
REQ-005.tasks_rationale: Task 5.1, Task 5.2, and Task 7.1 cover ImePipelineAndContextTest.kt and InputContextEvaluator/InputConnectionCommitter implementation.
REQ-005.debate_rationale: ADR-005 evaluates cursor selection tracking via onUpdateSelection and rejects setComposingText due to WebView autocomplete duplication and underline artifacts.

REQ-006.design_rationale: Section 3.2.3 specifies SmartSwitchStore.kt per-package language persistence wired to OpenKeyImeService.onStartInputView.
REQ-006.tasks_rationale: Task 5.1, Task 5.2, and Task 7.1 specify unit tests and implementation for SmartSwitchStore.
REQ-006.debate_rationale: ADR-006 justifies EditorInfo.packageName inspection in onStartInputView and rejects AccessibilityService foreground app detection.

REQ-007.design_rationale: Section 3.3.1 specifies PhoneLayoutMetrics.kt, PhoneLayoutConfig, KeyboardLayoutDefinition.kt, and KeyboardScreen.kt replicating the Samsung Galaxy A37 One UI 5-row layout, 5% home-row inset, !#1/1/2/2/2 symbol layers, One UI Light/Dark themes, 14dp chin, and One-Handed mode.
REQ-007.tasks_rationale: Task 6.1, Task 6.2, Task 7.2, and Task 11.1 define layout metric unit tests, Compose UI implementation, and phone-dedicated class naming (PhoneLayoutMetrics).
REQ-007.debate_rationale: ADR-007 and ADR-015 justify Samsung One UI stock keyboard layout parity and phone-dedicated naming over generic Material pill buttons or tablet LargeScreen naming.

REQ-008.design_rationale: Section 3.3.2 specifies KeyboardGestureController.kt for Spacebar 12dp trackpad cursor control, Backspace 24dp swipe-delete, 220ms long-press symbol/vowel popups, and keycap haptics.
REQ-008.tasks_rationale: Task 6.1, Task 6.2, and Task 7.2 cover unit tests and Compose pointer gesture integration.
REQ-008.debate_rationale: ADR-008 analyzes screen-edge gesture non-interference and rejects full-keyboard glide typing due to Vietnamese Telex end-of-syllable tone ambiguity.

REQ-009.design_rationale: Section 1 and Section 3.4 specify the touch-only phone scope for the Samsung Galaxy A37, removing HardwareKeyMapper.kt and hardware key interception methods from KeyboardSessionController and OpenKeyImeService.
REQ-009.tasks_rationale: Task 11.2 specifies deleting HardwareKeyMapper.kt and removing onHardwareKeyDown, onHardwareKeyUp, and processHardwareKey with corresponding unit test updates.
REQ-009.debate_rationale: ADR-015 explicitly supersedes ADR-009, documenting the trade-offs of dedicating the phone codebase strictly to on-screen touch typing.

REQ-010.design_rationale: Section 3.4 specifies OpenKeySettingsStore.kt, KeyValueStorage with Direct-Boot device-protected SharedPreferences, OpenKeyL10n.kt (VI/EN), ImeComposeLifecycleOwner.kt, and SettingsActivity.kt.
REQ-010.tasks_rationale: Task 6.1, Task 6.2, Task 7.1, and Task 7.3 cover settings clamping, localization, lifecycle owner, and SettingsActivity UI.
REQ-010.debate_rationale: ADR-010 evaluates device-protected storage security trade-offs for Direct Boot lock-screen readiness and rejects deprecated XML KeyboardView.

REQ-011.design_rationale: Section 3.5 defines KeyboardSessionController.kt centralizing touch keystroke routing, EditorUiState reactivity, bypassVietnamese enforcement on touch keys, and Enter action/newline dispatch.
REQ-011.tasks_rationale: Task 9.1, Task 9.2, Task 10.1, and Task 11.2 cover KeyboardSessionController unit tests, implementation, and touch-only refinement.
REQ-011.debate_rationale: ADR-011 and ADR-015 justify centralizing session orchestration in :openkey-core via TextCommitterTarget and reject duplicating state across KeyboardScreen and OpenKeyImeService.

REQ-012.design_rationale: Section 3.5 specifies the Commit-First keystroke pipeline in KeyboardSessionController and VietnameseEngine, static lookup tables and prewarmAsync() in VietnameseDictionary, and generation-tagged async candidate computation in AutoWordingEngine.
REQ-012.tasks_rationale: Task 9.1, Task 9.2, and Task 10.1 specify SmoothArchitectureTest assertions and implementation across VietnameseEngine, VietnameseDictionary, AutoWordingEngine, and KeyboardSessionController.
REQ-012.debate_rationale: ADR-012 evaluates synchronous vs asynchronous candidate emission trade-offs and rejects blocking character commits on main-thread dictionary sorting.

REQ-013.design_rationale: Section 3.5 defines selection tracking in BatchReplacementCoordinator and zero-IPC-read cursor movement in InputConnectionCommitter.moveCursorBy without calling getExtractedText.
REQ-013.tasks_rationale: Task 9.1, Task 9.2, and Task 10.1 cover selection tracking and zero-getExtractedText verification in SmoothArchitectureTest and OpenKeyAndroidAppTest.
REQ-013.debate_rationale: ADR-013 analyzes DPAD/selection-offset cursor movement and rejects synchronous getExtractedText Binder IPC reads at 120Hz.

REQ-014.design_rationale: Section 3.5 specifies ConcurrentHashMap layer caching in KeyboardLayoutDefinition, LiveCandidateStripHost recomposition isolation in KeyboardScreen, and single-pass Modifier.drawBehind keycap rendering in KeyButton.
REQ-014.tasks_rationale: Task 9.1, Task 9.2, and Task 10.1 verify referential layer caching (===) and implement LiveCandidateStripHost and drawBehind keycaps.
REQ-014.debate_rationale: ADR-014 evaluates custom Canvas bevel rendering vs multi-layer shadow modifiers and rejects root-level candidate state recomposition.

REQ-015.design_rationale: Section 1 and Section 3.5 define the 1,000-keystroke continuous mixed Vietnamese/English hot-path benchmark in SmoothArchitectureTest asserting < 0.2ms average per-keystroke latency.
REQ-015.tasks_rationale: Task 9.1, Task 9.2, and Task 10.2 implement and execute SmoothArchitectureTest to verify the < 0.2ms latency budget.
REQ-015.debate_rationale: ADR-012 establishes the < 0.2ms hot-path latency target (> 40x faster than the 8.33ms 120Hz frame budget) through commit-first execution.

REQ-016.design_rationale: Section 1 maps REQ-016 and ADR-016 to .github/workflows/android-ci.yml, Sources/OpenKey/android/gradle.properties, and Sources/OpenKey/android/.gitignore for portable JDK 21 builds and automated APK artifact publishing.
REQ-016.tasks_rationale: Task 12.1 and Task 12.2 define making gradle.properties portable, adding .gitignore, creating .github/workflows/android-ci.yml, pushing to origin, and verifying the GitHub Actions run.
REQ-016.debate_rationale: ADR-016 evaluates ubuntu-latest vs macOS runner speed/cost trade-offs and rejects hardcoded local JDK paths in gradle.properties.
